text.en: This Order may be cited as the Arbitration (Amendment) Order, 2016.

Section 13 of the Arbitration Order, 2009, in this Order referred to as the principal Order, is amended, in subsection (8), by deleting "President of the Arbitration Association of Brunei Darussalam" and by substituting "Chairman of the Brunei Darussalam Arbitration Centre" therefor.

Section 62 of the principal Order is amended, in subsection (I), by deleting "President of the Arbitration Association of Brunei Darussalam" from the sixth line and by substituting "Chairman of the Brunei Darussalam Arbitration Centre" therefor.

Any appointment made by the President of the Arbitration Association of Brunei Darussalarn under sections 13 and 62 of the principal Order and in force immediately before the commencement of this Order shall continue to be in force as if made by the Chairman of the Brunei Darussalam Arbitration Centre. Made this 24th. day of Zulhijjah, 1437 Hijriah corresponding to the 26th. day of September, 2016 at Our Istana Nurul Iman, Bandar Seri Begawan, Brunei Darussalam.

THE SULTAN AND YANG DI-PERTUAN

BRUNEI DARUSSALAM
